name: Hexahedron Projection for Curvilinear Grids
definition: A method to classify projections of hexahedra from curvilinear meshes into triangle fans or strips for hardware rendering, avoiding the computational geometry complexity of general line-sweep subdivision by handling specific topological cases.
summary: Hexahedron Projection for Curvilinear Grids is a viewpoint-dependent cell-projection method that renders hexahedra as pre-defined triangle fans or strips, avoiding the complexity of general line-sweep subdivision methods.
